summary: Copley Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on the NYSE under COPLU/COPL/COPLW, filed an 8-K reporting an October 6, 2026 amended and restated convertible promissory note issued to its sponsor, Copley Acquisition Sponsors LLC. The note lifts the maximum principal from $450,000 to $900,000, bears no interest, and matures on the earlier of a business combination's effective date or liquidation. The sponsor may convert outstanding amounts into units at $7.00 per unit, each unit being one share plus one-half warrant. Repayment is limited to funds outside the trust. Watch the conversion overhang and any extension or de-SPAC timeline.
